hypothesis: Post-allocation vetoes strand admissible entries, while independent stock exits permit repeated correlated replacement losses. Apply observed admission before ranking/funding and one existing actual-account risk authority before issuing unit intents. Forecast utility ranks admitted names; its inherited absolute return-like entry threshold is not a calibration claim.

forecast.reuse: Use exact previously issued prefix/full forecasts and training receipts after full source, universe, calendar, archive and content verification. Never subset a forecast trained on a larger pool. Unavailable exact forecasts are an explicit error in this bounded comparison, not permission to refit.

admission: Fresh ready quote, rising observed EMA60, close above EMA60 and EMA20, positive five-session momentum, tail probability below 0.5, recovered prior individual exit; broad observed universe trend must be open. Apply all predicates before ranking, truncating to available slots or assigning actual cash. Do not require utility >0.005. No name/date exceptions.

ranking.price: Existing independent production causal Features.score, descending

holding: Preserve actual economic units; new-name cap 0.6 and retained-name ceiling 0.8 (singleton 1), same as parent. Do not harvest intact winners for daily weight drift. Retain the parent's observed two-close EMA60 break, negative-utility/EMA60 confirmation, tail-and-loss, single-day 8% loss and stale-quote exits. Full exits latch until actual liquidation.
rotation: Only every 20 sessions when full: replace the weakest held name only if its rank falls below twice capacity and the best admissible outsider exceeds 1.25 times max(weakest score,0.001). Latch the full exit; never finance the entrant with intended proceeds.
account_risk: Use existing Config() and RiskState unchanged, updating once per observed session from actual filled-account NAV and independent same-universe Features. Cap reductions issue fixed economic-unit ceilings which survive rejected fills. Do not recalculate a half-sale as half of residual units. A later recovery cannot cancel an unfilled protective reduction. Block new risk while any full exit or protective unit reduction is outstanding.
restoration: Use only actual cash within the current risk cap. A confirmed cap increase permits funding intact admissible holdings as well as vacancies, with equal incremental cash and per-name ceilings. Keep the restoration intent until a funded target is observed or revoked by a new risk cut. Ordinary vacant-slot entries remain possible from actual cash after exits settle. No zero-NAV-return recovery condition and no virtual-sale proceeds.
cap_drift: The inherited Config.trade_band (0.08) is allowed between risk changes; a risk reduction itself has no band. On exceeding cap plus band, reduce to cap using a fixed-unit intent. Config, costs, volume limits, calendar, T+1 and matching are unchanged.
comparison: Two candidates, three core pools, selection only through 2025-12-31. Reuse finite_study's declared worst-deficit then objective then fills/candidate ordering unchanged. Preserve every raw result including failure. Full-period and 2026 windows are retrospective diagnostics; original four-reference and generalization acceptance remains necessary.
non_goals: Do not alter the frozen parent modules/contracts, expand the old grid, raise baseline thresholds, or promote core-only engineering/economic screens to universal acceptance. Do not copy any of the four external strategies.
